description: This PHP source file defines the WeightClass controller class for the Admin panel of OpenCart, handling CRUD operations and views related to weight class entities within the localisation module.

classes.name: WeightClass
classes.description: Controller class responsible for managing weight classes in the admin localisation section, including listing, form handling, saving, and deleting weight classes.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Loads the main weight class list view, setting up breadcrumbs, page title, and including header, footer, and left column controllers.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Delegates to getList() to output the list of weight classes.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves and displays a paginated list of weight classes, including links for editing and pagination controls.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays a form for creating or editing a weight class, loading existing data if editing.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles form submission to add or update a weight class, validating input and permissions.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected weight classes after permission check and validation that they are not default or associated with products.
